newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 133-day BBCs at 2.204 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 133-day BBCs at 2.204 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 466 million reais of 133-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight rate of 2.204 percent a month, dealers said.

It was the first time the Central Bank had offered 133-day BBCs, replacing 56-day BBCs. The sale was seen as part of the government's current policy to stretch the maturity period of Brazil's public debt, dealers said.
The Central Bank also sold 1.36 billion reais in 182-day BBCs at an overnight rate of 2.257 percent a month, down from 2.287 percent last week.
The result of the auction indicated 674 million reais will be added to the banking system as 2.5 billion reais in 56-day bonds come due Wednesday.
